A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same local-complexity framework. Their text, equations, figures, and appendices A–C support comparison, including the additional Appendix C.4 in v3.

before.justification: v1 reports original neural-network experiments on Stanford Bunny image fitting, correlated Gaussian data, and MNIST, including training dynamics, ablations, and adversarial-accuracy measurements.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds CIFAR-10 and Imagenette training results in Appendix C.4 and Figure 14.

M1.justification: The local-complexity construction, Gaussian bias perturbations, gradient-based estimation procedure, and local-rank measure are retained. The additional datasets do not establish a change to the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Appendix C.4 adds CIFAR-10 and Imagenette classification experiments. This substantially broadens the represented data from Gaussian mappings, grayscale image fitting, and handwritten digits to higher-dimensional natural-image classification.

E2.justification: No evaluated comparison method is added or removed. The new discussion of MLPs performing poorly relative to CNNs does not include an actual CNN comparison.

E3.justification: The retained experiments preserve their stated architectures, optimizer settings, initialization scales, and evaluation measures. C.4 extends LC and accuracy measurements to additional datasets without documenting a distinct new split, preprocessing, or attack protocol.

E4.justification: C.4 adds a check of whether decreasing local complexity and improving adversarial accuracy also occur on natural-image datasets. The existing noise, initialization, bound-tightness, representation-rank, and weight-decay analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Figure 7 retains six runs with different cross-covariance matrices and standard-deviation error bars; Figure 9 retains eight runs and confidence intervals. Figure 14 introduces no additional repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: Figure 14 adds LC and train/test/adversarial-accuracy trajectories for CIFAR-10 and Imagenette. Existing results remain, including Figure 7 correlations of 0.852, 0.957, and 0.985 and Figure 13's R-squared of 0.6972. The additions are new-setting results, not same-setting performance gains.

T1.justification: Theorem 2, equation (6), changes from equality to approximate equality in both the main text and Appendix A.3.4. No approximation error or revised derivation accompanies this change: its proof, the Corollary 3 derivation, and B.1 still use equality. The remaining theoretical content is retained apart from notation clarifications and renumbering.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims connecting local complexity with representation rank, total variation, robustness, and optimization. The additional experiments support these existing claims without redefining them.

C2.justification: C.4 interprets the additional experiments as evidence that the observed behavior extends beyond the original settings. It also explicitly limits that evidence because MLP performance is poor on these tasks and high-dimensional LC estimation is computationally demanding and memory-intensive.

D1.justification: Figure 3 newly clarifies that its existing 1,000-image MNIST subset spans all classes, and B.1 explicitly identifies use of Humayun et al.'s visualization implementation. These are documentation refinements; detailed configurations for the added datasets are not supplied.

R1.justification: v3 adds Howard (2019) for Imagenette and Krizhevsky and Hinton (2009) for CIFAR-10. The theoretical positioning relative to prior linear-region, representation-learning, and grokking research remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 streamlines motivation and explanatory passages, shortens the Section 3.1 heading, corrects several cross-references, aligns repeated theorem numbering, and adds an Impact Statement. The overall narrative and section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: The main text and references switch from a single-column preprint to a two-column conference layout. Figures 2–3 are redrawn with gridlines and revised panel presentation, appendix figures are resized and repositioned, and Figure 14 adds a new four-panel display.

improvement.justification: Figure 14 broadens empirical support, C.4 states useful limitations, and presentation edits improve readability. However, v3 replaces the foundational Theorem 2 equality with an unexplained approximation while retaining an exact proof and downstream uses. The added experiments also lack detailed settings. These limited gains and the unresolved mathematical inconsistency leave the net quality effect uncertain.
